titleZh: 秩序 ↔ 混亂｜條理尺 vs 糊塗桶
hook: 條理尺對糊塗桶——場面語氣對打。

members.speakLineEn: Her methodical checklist kept the science fair booth calm and on time.
members.speakLineZh: 她有條理的核對清單，讓科展攤位保持冷靜準時。

members.speakLineEn: A systematic review of the data revealed the same error in every week.
members.speakLineZh: 系統性檢視資料後，發現每週都有同一個錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: Disciplined practice each morning improved his piano speed and accuracy.
members.speakLineZh: 每天早上有紀律的練習，提升了他鋼琴的速度與準度。

members.speakLineEn: Please keep your desk tidy so the next class can find shared supplies.
members.speakLineZh: 請保持桌面整齊，好讓下一班找到共用文具。

members.speakLineEn: Careful ratiocination led her from clues to the only possible culprit.
members.speakLineZh: 仔細推理讓她從線索推到唯一可能的兇手。

members.speakLineEn: The storm wreaked havoc on power lines across the coastal towns.
members.speakLineZh: 暴風雨對沿海城鎮的電線造成大混亂與破壞。

members.speakLineEn: Political turmoil delayed the opening of the new public library.
members.speakLineZh: 政治騷動延遲了新公共圖書館的開幕。

related.synonyms: convulsion, upheaval, tumult, agitation, excitement, hullabaloo

members.speakLineEn: A sudden tumult in the square forced shops to pull down their shutters.
members.speakLineZh: 廣場突如其來的混亂暴動，迫使店家拉下鐵門。

members.speakLineEn: She sorted through a welter of receipts before filing the tax forms.
members.speakLineZh: 報稅前，她先整理一堆混亂雜亂的收據。

related.synonyms: clutter, jumble, muddle, fuddle, smother, wallow

members.speakLineEn: A hallway ruckus over lost headphones interrupted the quiet study hour.
members.speakLineZh: 走廊因耳機遺失引發的騷亂喧鬧，打斷了安靜自習時間。

members.speakLineEn: Mixed instructions can muddle beginners who need one clear sequence.
members.speakLineZh: 混亂的指示會使需要單一清楚步驟的初學者更糊塗。

related.synonyms: clutter, jumble, fuddle, welter, smother, fix

members.speakLineEn: An accident created a traffic snarl that stretched for three blocks.
members.speakLineZh: 一起車禍造成長達三個街區的交通混亂堵塞。

related.synonyms: tangle, maze, snap, entangle, mat, embrangle

members.speakLineEn: Riotous cheering filled the gym after the last-second winning shot.
members.speakLineZh: 最後一秒決勝球進後，體育館充滿暴亂般的喧鬧歡呼。

related.synonyms: exuberant, lush, luxuriant, profuse, disruptive, troubled

members.speakLineEn: The sudden schedule change left him discombobulated and missing books.
members.speakLineZh: 突然改課表讓他混亂困惑，還把書忘了帶。

related.synonyms: bewilder, bemuse, discombobulate, throw, confuse, fox

members.speakLineEn: Too many alarms can addle a tired student during morning study time.
members.speakLineZh: 鬧鐘太多會在晨讀時把疲倦學生弄得糊塗混亂。

members.speakLineEn: She grew flustered when the microphone cut out mid-sentence.
members.speakLineZh: 麥克風講到一半斷掉時，她變得慌張混亂。

members.speakLineEn: His unkempt hair and wrinkled shirt suggested he had overslept again.
members.speakLineZh: 凌亂的頭髮與皺襯衫，顯示他又睡過頭了。

members.speakLineEn: The canceled concert caused an uproar among fans waiting at the gate.
members.speakLineZh: 演唱會取消在門口等候的粉絲間引發喧鬧騷動。

related.synonyms: tumult, tumultuousness, garboil, hubbub, brouhaha, katzenjammer

members.speakLineEn: Without clear rules, the debate turned into a noisy free-for-all.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有清楚規則，辯論變成一場嘈雜混亂的混戰。

members.speakLineEn: The scruffy suitcase had broken zippers and stains from long travel.
members.speakLineZh: 那只骯髒破舊的行李箱拉鍊壞了，還有長途旅行的污漬。

members.speakLineEn: Players huddle near the bench to whisper the next defensive play.
members.speakLineZh: 球員在板凳旁擠成一團，低聲密商下一波防守。

members.speakLineEn: The visiting team suffered a rout and lost by more than thirty points.
members.speakLineZh: 客隊慘遭潰敗，輸了超過三十分。

related.synonyms: mob, rabble, expel, root, rootle, gouge

members.speakLineEn: A spontaneous song broke out when the power returned to the subway.
members.speakLineZh: 捷運恢復供電時，自然而然地爆發出一首自發的歌。

members.speakLineEn: The long trek through muddy hills left everyone's boots soaked.
members.speakLineZh: 穿越泥濘山丘的艱苦跋涉，讓大家的靴子全濕透。

members.speakLineEn: A brief tussle over the last umbrella ended with shared laughter.
members.speakLineZh: 為最後一把傘扭打爭執片刻後，雙方笑著和解。
